So I was thinking of this idea for a Voat corp, and then I started to wonder, "Who the fuck is going to be in charge of this thing?"

As a former CEO of several EVE corps, both successful and unsuccessful, I have seen how much leadership matters, especially to a new corp just getting kicked off. No offense to u/Firetail, but I don't think he should be CEO by default just because he's the mod of this subverse and proposed the idea (I do appreciate everything you've done bro.) Being a good CEO requires a good grasp of the game, a vision of what he wants to see the corp culture develop into - tempered by a willingness to let the members do their own thing, a plan for dealing with the inevitable attacks both internal and external, a willingness to delegate, and most importantly a lot of free time to play EVE.

First let me say that there is no way I will ever be a CEO again - I'd like to resub for this corp mainly to do solo/small gang PvP and do help FC and maybe teach some newbros how to shoot people in the face, but I just don't have the time or energy to be a CEO, so I'm not trying to take over or anything like that.

My suggestion would be that we start a thread for anyone interested to outline their ideas about how they want to run things and let the voats decide. There isn't really a pretty way to go about this, and if it turns into an inconclusive clusterfuck we could just let u/Firetail decree who the boss is and live with it.

These are definitely great points to bring up. I think our first issue is gaining popularity for this subverse. Gaining subscribers would result in an increase in the number of players that could help provide insight on the best way to approach things like this, as well as providing us with a larger number of base members to join in on the fun. As of now, I dont think this sub is large enough to foster a successful corporation.

I think there needs to be a push of some kind for more advertisement of this sub, both internally on Voat, and externally through different branches of social media.

Personally, I don't know enough about EVE to make these kinds of decisions. But in regards to defining the role of leadership, and choosing who will be the CEO, it should definitely be a decision based in the community's desires.

I agree and have no desire to be CEO of the corp just because I am the moderator of the sub. In fact I've specifically left it up to you all to get the ball rolling and set up the corp and stuff and just been stickying the posts and whatnot.
